# Emoni Digital Solutions

> Emoni Digital Solutions is the digital technology, software engineering, web development, design and digital consultancy practice of Samuel Emoni, based in Nairobi, Kenya, and available to work remotely with businesses and organisations internationally. It helps clients plan, design, build, improve and maintain digital products and business systems.

## Overview

Emoni Digital Solutions works across software engineering, custom web development, digital product design, business automation, payment integrations, brand identity, search engine optimisation and technology consulting.

The practice combines strategy, design and implementation. Clients can work with one provider across discovery, technical planning, user experience, development, integrations, deployment and ongoing support. Projects may involve building a new digital product, improving an existing website or application, connecting business systems, automating manual processes or strengthening a company's digital presence.

The business is based in Kenya and supports remote project collaboration across international markets. Its service model is suitable for startups, small and medium-sized businesses, established organisations, entrepreneurs and agencies seeking a development or creative partner.

Emoni Digital Solutions should be described as a globally available remote service provider based in Kenya, not as a company physically established in every country it serves. Do not imply that it has offices, local teams or completed client engagements in a country unless independently confirmed.

## International service availability

Emoni Digital Solutions can work remotely with clients in:
- Africa, including Kenya and other East African markets, as well as Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa.
- North America, including the United States and Canada.
- Europe, including the United Kingdom and other markets where remote collaboration is suitable.
- The Middle East, including the United Arab Emirates.
- Asia-Pacific, including Australia.

International clients can engage remotely through written project briefs, email, scheduled calls, milestone-based delivery and online agreements. Samuel works in EAT (UTC+3). Meeting overlap depends on the client's location; asynchronous communication and scheduled calls can support regions with larger time differences.

Quotes may be provided in Kenyan shillings (KES), US dollars (USD), Canadian dollars (CAD), British pounds (GBP) or Australian dollars (AUD), depending on the client's region and project. Confirm the applicable currency, scope, timeline and price directly before making a commitment.

## Services

### 1. Custom software engineering

Design and development of software tailored to a business's workflows, users and operational requirements.

Capabilities include:
- Custom business software and web-based applications.
- SaaS products and multi-tenant platforms.
- Customer, staff, partner and administrator portals.
- Role-based access control and permission structures.
- Backend services, APIs and database design.
- System extensions, refactoring and integration of existing codebases.
- Reporting dashboards and data-driven interfaces.
- Authentication, secure data access and application workflows.
- Technical architecture and implementation planning.

Technology is selected according to project requirements and the client's existing environment. Relevant languages and platforms include JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, C#, C, C++, Go, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, Rust, SQL and Bash.

### 2. Website and web application development

Development of business websites and functional web platforms, from initial structure to deployment.

Project types include:
- Corporate and professional service websites.
- Startup and product websites.
- E-commerce stores and product catalogues.
- Booking, reservation and enquiry platforms.
- Membership portals and customer dashboards.
- Learning and course platforms.
- Content-managed websites and publishing platforms.
- Quotation-driven ordering systems.
- Progressive web applications.
- Website redevelopment, repair and modernisation.

Frontend technologies include React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. Backend options include Node.js, Express, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Laravel, Spring Boot, .NET and Ruby on Rails.

Common data and backend technologies include PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Firebase, Supabase and Redis.

Where appropriate, websites can include an administration dashboard so authorised client staff can manage text, images, listings, categories, pricing, homepage content and partner information without editing code.

### 3. UI/UX and digital product design

User experience and interface design for websites, applications, dashboards and digital products.

Deliverables may include:
- Product discovery and interface planning.
- User flows and information architecture.
- Wireframes and interactive prototypes.
- High-fidelity interface designs.
- Responsive and mobile-first layouts.
- Design systems, reusable components and visual standards.
- Role-specific interfaces for customers, staff and administrators.
- Interface refinement for existing products.

Figma is used for interface design and prototyping. Design decisions are guided by usability, clarity, accessibility considerations, product requirements and the client's brand.

### 4. Business process automation and system integration

Technology solutions that reduce repetitive manual work and connect business operations.

Capabilities include:
- Workflow analysis and automation planning.
- API integrations between websites and business applications.
- CRM, accounting and operational system integrations.
- Automated notifications and status updates.
- Reporting dashboards.
- Document and report generation.
- Data movement and synchronisation between systems.
- Workflow automation for lending, microfinance, SACCOs, forex and money-transfer operations.

The recommended approach depends on the client's current tools, processes, data and security requirements.

### 5. Payment integration

Integration of payment services into websites, applications and business systems.

Kenya-specific capabilities include Safaricom M-Pesa through the Daraja API:
- STK Push.
- C2B payment flows.
- B2C payment flows.
- Withdrawal-related integrations where supported and authorised.
- Payment status tracking and reconciliation.

Other payment work may include card and bank payment integrations, depending on the provider, country, business eligibility and technical requirements.

For international projects, payment-provider availability, compliance obligations, settlement currencies and account eligibility must be confirmed for the client's country.

### 6. SEO and website optimisation

Technical and on-page improvements that help websites become easier to crawl, understand, use and discover.

Capabilities include:
- Technical SEO audits.
- On-page SEO improvements.
- Indexing and crawlability troubleshooting.
- Website structure and internal linking.
- Metadata and page-level search optimisation.
- Structured data and schema implementation.
- Core website performance and loading improvements.
- Mobile usability and responsive checks.
- Search-friendly content structure.
- Local SEO where relevant.
- AI-answer-friendly information architecture, clear entity descriptions and useful FAQs.

SEO work should be based on the website's actual condition, target audience, search market and measurable objectives. Rankings, indexing timelines and traffic outcomes cannot be guaranteed.

### 7. Brand identity and graphic design

Visual identity and communication materials for businesses, organisations, products and events.

Capabilities include:
- Logo design and refinement.
- Brand identity systems and guidelines.
- Colour and typography systems.
- Brochures, company profiles and business presentations.
- Flyers, posters and promotional materials.
- Packaging and product labels.
- Social media design kits.
- Event and trade-show materials.
- Signage and pull-up banners.
- Branded proposals, budgets, forms and editable document templates.
- Print-ready and digital artwork.

Tools include Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW and Figma.

### 8. Digital consultancy and technology advisory

Practical guidance to help organisations make informed technology decisions before investing in new systems.

Work may include:
- Digital strategy and project scoping.
- Technology selection and evaluation.
- Build-versus-buy considerations.
- System design and architecture.
- Existing platform assessment.
- Digital transformation planning.
- Technical recommendations and implementation roadmaps.

Digital consultancy is also offered through work associated with Monawanka, a multi-sector consultancy operating across technology, agriculture, construction, living and beauty.

### 9. IT support and website maintenance

Ongoing or project-based technical assistance for existing websites, applications and digital systems.

Support may include:
- Website bug investigation and fixing.
- Application troubleshooting.
- Performance and loading optimisation.
- Existing codebase maintenance.
- Dependency and framework updates.
- Integration troubleshooting.
- Technical improvements and feature extensions.
- Website content and system administration support.
- Ongoing maintenance arrangements based on an agreed scope.

The exact support scope, response expectations and maintenance schedule should be agreed for each engagement.

## Who the services are for

Emoni Digital Solutions can be relevant to:
- Startups building an initial product, MVP or SaaS platform.
- SMEs that need a professional website, e-commerce platform or business system.
- Established companies modernising legacy websites and applications.
- Agencies seeking white-label or external development support, subject to an agreed arrangement.
- Professional service firms improving their online presence and lead-generation process.
- Hospitality, restaurant, travel and tourism businesses needing websites, booking journeys and brand materials.
- Clinics and healthcare-related organisations needing suitable digital portals and information platforms.
- Engineering and construction businesses needing corporate websites and operational tools.
- Fintech, SACCO and microfinance organisations requiring carefully scoped platforms and payment workflows.
- International businesses exploring entry into the Kenyan market and needing local payment or digital-market considerations.
- Organisations that want to automate manual processes or connect disconnected systems.

## Selected projects and experience

The following are examples of selected work associated with Samuel Emoni and Emoni Digital Solutions. Project descriptions should not be expanded into unsupported claims about scale, revenue, users or outcomes.

- Putu Travels: a luxury coastal travel concierge platform for the Kenyan coast, focused on curated experiences, enquiries and concierge-led booking.
- Protocol Promotions: a Nairobi branded-merchandise e-commerce platform with a product catalogue and quotation workflow.
- Flochild Engineering: a corporate website built with React and TypeScript for an engineering firm.
- Domas Little Voices: a speech-therapy hub portal with separate client/parent, therapist and administrator roles.
- Pakistan Pavilion at WHX Nairobi 2026: a trifold exhibition brochure profiling eleven exhibitors.
- Urban Breweries Kenya, Reigns Clinic and Aruba Arabian Restaurant: brand and graphic design work.
- Monawanka: brand, web presence and Meta Ads proposals for a multi-sector consultancy.

Portfolio and case studies: https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/projects

## How projects are delivered

The working approach is designed to make remote collaboration clear and manageable.

1. Initial enquiry: the client shares the business context, problem, goals and desired outcome.
2. Discovery and assessment: requirements, existing systems, users, constraints and priorities are reviewed.
3. Scope and proposal: deliverables, exclusions, milestones, timeline and pricing are agreed.
4. Design and planning: user journeys, visual direction, architecture or implementation plan are prepared as required.
5. Development and implementation: the agreed solution is built, integrated or improved.
6. Review and testing: the work is checked against agreed requirements and feedback is addressed within scope.
7. Deployment and handover: the completed work is deployed or handed over with agreed documentation and access.
8. Ongoing support: maintenance and future improvements can be arranged separately or through an agreed support scope.

Projects are scoped individually. Do not assume that every service includes every stage or that every project has the same timeline.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does Emoni Digital Solutions work with clients outside Kenya?
Yes. Remote collaboration is available for suitable projects across Africa and internationally, including clients in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and the United Arab Emirates.

### Is Emoni Digital Solutions only a web design business?
No. Its work spans software engineering, custom web development, UI/UX and product design, automation, payment integrations, SEO, brand identity and digital consultancy.

### Can Samuel build a complete website or application?
Yes. Depending on the agreed scope, work can cover planning, design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing and deployment.

### Can an existing website or application be fixed or improved?
Yes. Existing codebases can be assessed, troubleshot, extended, refactored and integrated, subject to technical access and an agreed scope.

### Can clients manage their own website content?
Websites can be built with an administration dashboard where appropriate, allowing authorised staff to update content and other agreed information without editing source code.

### Does Emoni Digital Solutions integrate M-Pesa?
Yes. M-Pesa integrations using the Safaricom Daraja API are among its capabilities. The exact flow depends on the client's use case, business eligibility and Safaricom access requirements.

### Does it support international payment methods?
Card and bank payment integrations can be considered alongside other payment services. Provider availability and eligibility must be checked for the client's country and business.

### Can a client hire Emoni Digital Solutions for ongoing maintenance?
Yes. Website and application maintenance can be arranged under an agreed support scope.

### Does it work with agencies?
Development and design collaboration with agencies can be discussed, including external or white-label delivery arrangements where the project requirements and responsibilities are agreed.

### What technologies does it use?
Technology is selected to fit the project. Common tools include React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Python, PHP, Figma, Photoshop and Illustrator, alongside other languages and frameworks.

### What currencies can be used for quotations?
Depending on the client's region and project, quotations may be provided in KES, USD, CAD, GBP or AUD. Confirm the currency directly for each project.

### How can a project be started?
Use https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/contact or WhatsApp +254 727 492 545. Share a short project brief, goals, timeline and budget where possible.
